title: PCSK9 inhibitor
notice: Fictional exercise criteria. Not a payer policy, prescribing guide, or clinical recommendation. Draft for pharmacist review. Modeled on common documentation patterns, without reproducing a real policy.
request_date_rule: Use the provider letter request date. Conflicting source dates require review.
logic: All five criteria require evidence. Missing evidence is not a denial. Contradiction, unclear duration, and unreadable evidence require review.

criteria.text: Established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease is documented.
LDL-C is at least 70 mg/dL, measured within 180 days before the request.
An atorvastatin trial lasting at least 90 days is documented, or intolerance is documented.
The requested evolocumab dose is 140 mg every 2 weeks.
